title: Repeat with a counter
summary: COBOL: Repeat with a counter. Stop after 4.
introduction: PERFORM VARYING updates a counter and repeats until its stop rule is true.
learningObjectives: Repeat with a counter with COBOL

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.

blocks.title: Repeat with a counter
blocks.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 N PIC 9.
procedure division.
PERFORM VARYING N FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N > 3
 DISPLAY N
END-PERFORM
stop run.

blocks.text: N starts at 1 and increases each pass. The loop stops when N reaches 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check that the counter changes toward the stopping rule.
